annotations.title: Roof figures for a district or town

description: What our own solar roof check found over the family houses of a München district or of a town with a subsidy page: the typical house (modules, kWp, kWh a year), how many houses have room for a good system, the share of the household's power that comes from its own roof without and with a 5 or 10 kWh battery, the shade loss, and the area's own finding (what stands out against the rest of München). Totals and middle values over a sample of the area's houses, never a single house or address. With the link to the area's page. For a particular roof use find_house and plan_roof.

locale.description: Language of the answer: de (German) or en (English).

place.description: A München district (Stadtbezirk, e.g. "Pasing-Obermenzing", "Trudering", "Solln"; also its number or a neighbourhood in it) or a town with a subsidy page (e.g. "Pullach", "Garching"). Not found: the answer lists what is available.
